scope.source: Seeded synthetic BF16 public matrices with installed Flash tile geometry
scope.transport: framed pipes between separate client and evaluator processes on one GitHub runner

limitations: Synthetic geometry coverage, not actual Flash checkpoint or full-model encrypted generation
One runner and one observation per shape and step; hardware equivalence and separate-machine deployment not established
Logical legacy metadata reservation is a pressure scenario; real graph/proofs, request state and full-model mappings are absent
Weighted synthetic evaluator work is not measured Flash latency; trained values, client checks/replay/nonlinear work, source/cache I/O and transport are excluded
Sampled RSS sums double-count shared mappings and may miss brief peaks; cgroup memory includes file cache
Secret linear checks and sampled replay remain an unreviewed research integrity mechanism, not a malicious-security qualification
